segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Traim olsem wanem ol binata i senis taim ol i painim kaikai, kamapim pikinini na givim ol jin i senis long ol pikinini. Lukluk long wan wan binata na skelim namba bilong ol wantaim pasin bilong ol jin long ol graf.
